candidate_workaround: Normalize both the structural report text and the expected reservation phrase with Unicode casefold before asserting presence.
failure_signature: A case-sensitive structural accessibility assertion rejects semantically identical sentence-initial capitalization.
recurrence_guard: Use exact case only for case-significant syntax; use Unicode casefold for natural-language reservation phrases.
rollback: Restore the original assertion, retain the failure, and keep accessibility-complete claims false.
scope_boundary: Natural-language structural assertion only; it does not replace manual keyboard, browser, assistive-technology, Māori-language, or affected-user evaluation.
title: Case-normalized natural-language accessibility assertion
trigger_preconditions: A test checks a natural-language reservation phrase whose capitalization may differ only because of sentence position.
